purpose: Bounded original-source schema qualification after the stable GloBI dataset index proved too thin for geometry/time screening.

schema_requirements.taxon_pair: explicit sourceTaxon and targetTaxon mapped fields in globi.json
schema_requirements.geography: explicit latitude and longitude mapped fields
schema_requirements.replication_context: at least one explicit date/time or site/location/study/plot/sample field
schema_requirements.interaction_semantics: interaction type field or fixed interaction type in globi.json

order: complete taxon pair + lat/lon + temporal/context + interaction type

next_gate_if_pass: Inspect only source citation/README and sampling-design metadata for the frozen schema candidates; interaction rows remain sealed.
next_gate_if_hold: Stop GloBI primary paired time-space route under the current finite source family.
